title: XCreds (com.twocanoes.xcreds)
description: Managed preferences for XCreds by Twocanoes (BSD-3-Clause, github.com/twocanoes/xcreds): sign in to the Mac with a cloud identity provider (OIDC) and keep the local password in sync. XCreds requires a license after a 14-day trial; deliver it with the LicenseFile key or a separate profile.

discoveryURL.title: OpenID Connect discovery URL
discoveryURL.description: Your identity provider's .well-known/openid-configuration URL (Entra ID: https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/v2.0/.well-known/openid-configuration; Google: https://accounts.google.com/.well-known/openid-configuration).

clientID.title: Client ID
clientID.description: Application (client) ID registered with the identity provider.

clientSecret.title: Client secret
clientSecret.description: Client secret, if your provider requires one (Google does). Stored in the profile in clear text.

shouldShowCloudLoginByDefault.title: Show cloud login by default
shouldShowCloudLoginByDefault.description: Show the identity provider's sign-in page at the login window instead of the Mac login.

shouldPreferLocalLoginInsteadOfCloudLogi.title: Prefer local login
shouldPreferLocalLoginInsteadOfCloudLogi.description: Show the standard Mac login first.

shouldDetectNetworkToDetermineLoginWindo.title: Use local login when offline
shouldDetectNetworkToDetermineLoginWindo.description: Fall back to the Mac login window when there is no network.

shouldShowMacLoginButton.title: Show "Mac Login" button
shouldShowMacLoginButton.description: Let users switch to the standard login window.

shouldShowLocalOnlyCheckbox.title: Show local-only checkbox
shouldShowLocalOnlyCheckbox.description: Allow signing in with the local account only.

cloudLoginText.title: Cloud login button text
cloudLoginText.description: Label for the cloud sign-in button.

loginWindowBackgroundImageURL.title: Login window background image
loginWindowBackgroundImageURL.description: Path or URL of the background image.

loginWindowLogoPath.title: Login window logo
loginWindowLogoPath.description: Path of the logo shown at the login window.

shouldShowConfigureWifiButton.title: Show Wi-Fi button
shouldShowConfigureWifiButton.description: Let users join a Wi-Fi network from the login window.

map_username.title: Username claim
map_username.description: Token claim used for the local short name (default: name).

map_fullname.title: Full name claim
map_fullname.description: Token claim used for the full name (default: name).

map_uid.title: UID claim
map_uid.description: Token claim used for the numeric user ID.

aliasName.title: Alias claim
aliasName.description: Claim added as an alias of the local account, e.g. upn, so users can sign in with their email.

allowedUsersArray.title: Allowed users
allowedUsersArray.description: Only these users (matched against the allow-users claim) may sign in.

allowUsersClaim.title: Allow-users claim
allowUsersClaim.description: Claim compared with Allowed users (default: upn).

allowLoginIfMemberOfGroup.title: Allowed groups
allowLoginIfMemberOfGroup.description: Only members of these groups may sign in.

CreateAdminIfGroupMember.title: Admin groups
CreateAdminIfGroupMember.description: Members of these groups get admin accounts.

skipUserSetupBuddy.title: Skip Setup Assistant for new users

PasswordOverwriteSilent.title: Overwrite local password silently
PasswordOverwriteSilent.description: When the cloud password changed, update the local password without asking (needs an admin account configured via settingsOverrideScriptPath).

KeychainReset.title: Reset keychain if the password cannot be synced

verifyPassword.title: Verify the local password
verifyPassword.description: Ask users to confirm their local password when it differs.

refreshRateHours.title: Token refresh (hours)
refreshRateHours.description: How often XCreds re-checks the cloud password.

shouldUseROPGForLoginWindowLogin.title: Use ROPG at the login window
shouldUseROPGForLoginWindowLogin.description: Verify passwords with the resource-owner password grant (Entra ID).

shouldUseROPGForMenuLogin.title: Use ROPG in the menu bar app

shouldUseROPGForPasswordChangeChecking.title: Use ROPG to detect password changes

resource.title: ROPG resource
resource.description: Resource for ROPG requests, e.g. https://graph.microsoft.com.

shouldSetGoogleAccessTypeToOffline.title: Google: request offline access
shouldSetGoogleAccessTypeToOffline.description: Required for refresh tokens with Google Workspace.

passwordChangeURL.title: Password change URL
passwordChangeURL.description: Opened from the menu bar app's "Change Password" item.

shouldShowSignInMenuItem.title: Show "Sign In" in the menu bar app

shouldSwitchToLoginWindowWhenLocked.title: Use the XCreds login window when locked

settingsOverrideScriptPath.title: Settings override script
settingsOverrideScriptPath.description: Path of a root-owned script that supplies secrets such as the local admin credentials (keeps them out of profiles).
